Run explicit frozen-workflow configurations through native R scientific estimators

etr_frozen_workflow_execution.Rd

Construct source-field-aligned native R configuration records for frozen Python 1.2 common-grid FPCA, function-on-scalar regression and recurrence. Execute these configurations through existing Python-free native R scientific estimators. The source class names and fields are retained, but source Python backend, estimation-domain, timing and result dataclass equivalence remain unqualified and are not independent full-domain certifications.

Usage

etr_frozen_fpca_workflow_config(n_components = 0.95,
  scaling = "none", preprocessing = NULL)
etr_frozen_function_on_scalar_workflow_config(predictors,
  dimensions = NULL, participant_column = NULL, unit = "curve",
  preprocessing = NULL)
etr_frozen_recurrence_workflow_config(curve, dimensions,
  embedding_dimension, delay, radius, delay_units = "samples",
  metric = "euclidean", theiler_window = 0L,
  theiler_window_units = "samples", min_diagonal_length = 2L,
  min_vertical_length = 2L, preprocessing = NULL)
etr_frozen_workflow_decision_record(value, source, criterion = NULL)
etr_frozen_workflow_step_record(name, function_name, status,
  parameters = list(), elapsed_seconds, warnings = character())
etr_run_frozen_native_workflow(trajectories, config, design = NULL)

Arguments

n_components

Integer component count or finite variance proportion.

scaling

One of none or dimension_sd.

preprocessing

Native frozen preprocessing plan, NULL for an empty plan.

predictors

Explicit nonempty distinct regression predictor names.

dimensions

Explicit dimension names.

participant_column

Optional participant identifier for participant-level inference.

unit

curve or participant.

curve

Zero-based curve index or curve ID.

embedding_dimension

Positive integer delay embedding state dimension.

delay

Positive embedding delay: integer samples or finite positive physical-time duration (including fractional units).

radius

Positive recurrence radius.

delay_units

samples or convertible physical-time units on approximately regular observed grids.

metric

Recurrence distance: cityblock, euclidean, or chebyshev.

theiler_window

Nonnegative exclusion lag: integer samples or finite nonnegative physical-time duration (including fractional units).

theiler_window_units

samples or convertible physical-time units; resolve on the embedded grid.

min_diagonal_length

Minimum diagonal recurrence line length.

min_vertical_length

Minimum vertical recurrence line length.

value

Explicit scientific decision value.

source

Decision provenance analyst, audited_selector, workflow_contract or derived.

criterion

Explicit selector criterion when the decision source is audited.

name

Nonempty step name.

function_name

Explicit scientific callable identifier.

status

Step status: completed, failed or skipped.

parameters

Named parameters used by the step.

elapsed_seconds

Nonnegative finite observed step elapsed time.

warnings

Recorded warnings for the step.

trajectories

Native complete common-grid trajectory collection.

config

A frozen source-field native R workflow configuration record.

design

Curve-aligned regression design data frame for function-on-scalar.

Value

Constructor functions return native source-field-ordered S3 records, with unapproved source parity flags. etr_run_frozen_native_workflow returns an actual fitted native R workflow object.

Details

Only an empty preprocessing plan is executable, preserving a strict no-hidden-imputation rule. The native FPCA implementation does not currently accept floating 1.0 as a variance retention threshold, although the Python source config constructor does. L1, L2 and L-infinity recurrence distances are supported natively. Time-unit delays and Theiler windows may be fractional durations (for example 37.5 milliseconds). They resolve to exact integral sample lags on approximately regular grids. Fractional sample-count inputs, nonintegral physical-time conversions, incompatible units and irregular grids fail closed without interpolation.

Examples

cfg <- etr_frozen_fpca_workflow_config(n_components = 1L)
stopifnot(identical(cfg$n_components, 1L))
